# Maui Power Equipment

> Locally owned outdoor power equipment dealer at 970 Lower Main St, Wailuku, HI 96793 (Maui). Sales, walk-in service (no appointment needed), and parts for STIHL, Honda, SCAG, Wright, ECHO, Shindaiwa, Maruyama, and Hustler, plus generators and Big Tex trailers. Phone (808) 249-2730. Email Info@mauipowerequipment.com. Open Mon–Fri 7:30am–4:30pm, Sat 7:30am–2:00pm, closed Sunday.
